title: Assessment at 30 Degrees
note: Generated by tools/figures.py --extract from the page itself. Edit the verification and source fields; everything else is rewritten on the next extraction. A figure the reviewer corrects or deletes is marked REMOVED rather than removed from this file.

figures.claim: Valgus stress applied with the knee flexed to thirty degrees tests the superficial medial collateral ligament with the least help from anything else.
The grade is conventionally described in three degrees.
The thirty degree test is the most reproducible ligament examination in the knee, and more reproducible between examiners than any cruciate test.
